entries.title: Psalms 145:1
segments: ¶<<David's [Psalm] of praise.>> I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 145:2
segments: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 145:3
segments: Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness [is] unsearchable. {and his...: Heb. and of his greatness there is no search}

words.text: . {and his...: Heb. and of his greatness there is no search}

entries.title: Psalms 145:4
segments: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

entries.title: Psalms 145:5
segments: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works. {works: Heb. things, or, words}

entries.title: Psalms 145:6
segments: And [men] shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness. {declare: Heb. declare it}

entries.title: Psalms 145:7
segments: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 145:8
segments: The LORD [is] gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy. {of great...: Heb. great in mercy}

entries.title: Psalms 145:9
segments: The LORD [is] good to all: and his tender mercies [are] over all his works.

words.text: to all: and his tender mercies

entries.title: Psalms 145:10
segments: ¶All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.

entries.title: Psalms 145:11
segments: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;

entries.title: Psalms 145:12
segments: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

entries.title: Psalms 145:13
segments: Thy kingdom [is] an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion [endureth] throughout all generations. {an...: Heb. a kingdom of all ages}

words.text: . {an...: Heb. a kingdom of all ages}

entries.title: Psalms 145:14
segments: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all [those that be] bowed down.

entries.title: Psalms 145:15
segments: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season. {wait...: or, look unto}

entries.title: Psalms 145:16
segments: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

entries.title: Psalms 145:17
segments: The LORD [is] righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works. {holy: or, merciful, or, bountiful}

entries.title: Psalms 145:18
segments: The LORD [is] nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

words.text: upon him, to all that call

entries.title: Psalms 145:19
segments: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

entries.title: Psalms 145:20
segments: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

entries.title: Psalms 145:21
segments: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
